inputModel: V4 TestTableBuilder creates one real 136-entity GameState per state case; PlayerView.fromGameState, SessionUpdate.filterVisibleEvents and PublicProjectionFactory.project/publicEvents are called directly. No sleep/clock/random/ID source is read; every action/event/epoch is explicit.

mapping.v4PlayerViewToV5: V4 PlayerView / PublicBoardView fields map to V5 PlayerSnapshotView/PublicSnapshotView: wallRemaining, doraIndicators, scores (Int -> long), riichiStatus -> per-seat facts.Riichi, discards by river index, open melds by TableMeldFact, handTileCounts -> PlayerPublicView.HandCount, myClosedTiles -> Private.ClosedTiles, myDrawnTile -> Private.DrawnTileId, mySleeveTiles -> TableOwnerPrivateView.SleeveTiles (owner extension), myDiscardHistory -> TableSeatPrivateFacts.DiscardHistory.
mapping.wallMapping: V4 live-wall suffix [wallPointer, wallEndExclusive) is canonicalized to V5 dense Wall(0..N-1); V5 WallPointer is 0 and WallEndExclusive=N. The raw V4 pointers remain SOURCE_ONLY. V5 WallRemaining counts physical wall tiles and equals N.
mapping.deadWallMapping: V4 deadWall list index i -> V5 DeadWall(i). Dora indicators must be at index >= 4; this fixture uses index 4.
mapping.handMapping: V4 closedTiles list order -> V5 Hand(seat, 0..n-1); drawn tile -> Hand(seat, n) plus DrawnTileEvidence. V5 sorts by slot index, reproducing V4 list order.
mapping.meldMapping: V4 meld list index i -> V5 Meld(seat, i*4 + tileOffset). V4 MeldType/fromPlayer/calledTile -> TableMeldFact/MeldView input and output; both fromSeat and calledTileId are compared.
mapping.eventMapping: V4 TileDealt/TileDrawn/RinshanDraw -> ProtocolEventType private types with the owner seat; DoraRevealed(isUraDora) -> DoraRevealed; TileDiscarded/ChiDeclared/PonDeclared/KanDeclared/RiichiDeclared/DrawGame/ScoreSettled/RoundEnded/MatchEnded keep their names; V4 turnNumber/fromSeat/riichiDiscard/tsumogiri/wallRemaining/roundWind/roundNumber and TsumoWin yaku/han/fu/score/breakdown are supplied as TableProjectionEventFacts and compared through TableProjectionContractMapper.MapEvent payloads. V4 settlementEvents implies V5 SettlementBatch=true.
mapping.discardMapping: V4 river list index -> V5 DiscardView turnNumber=index. TileDiscarded riichiDiscard/tsumogiri flags are mapped as explicit facts and compared; only the per-river turnNumber assignment is a representation choice.
mapping.scoreMapping: V4 Int score -> V5 long ScoreView.Score, value-preserving. TsumoWin breakdown maps Han/Fu/TotalPoints/Yaku/DoraCount/UraCount/UraTiles/UraHits through ScoreBreakdownView. V4 breakdown.indicatorTiles/breakdown.score have no same-shape V5 field (SOURCE_ONLY); V4 uraHits group count is cross-checked against the flattened uraHitTiles list.
mapping.ownerMapping: V4 mySleeveTiles -> TableOwnerPrivateView.SleeveTiles -> MapPlayerSnapshot -> PrivatePlayerView.SleeveTiles for the owner; V4 meld metadata -> TableOwnerMeldView -> MeldView. Other seats/spectator never receive them.
mapping.authorizationMapping: uraAuthorized is not a V4 ScoreBreakdown property. The raw fixture event carries an explicit source-authorization adapter flag (true when raw ura identities are present); the C# caller chooses per-branch authorization and the expected canonical blocks record true/false. Raw identities with source authorization false are rejected; the mapper never strips automatically.
mapping.versionMapping: V5 state_version/event_seq/stream cursor are explicit fixture inputs; V4 PlayerView has no equivalent and they are STRUCTURE only, never compared to V4 values.

INPUT: events[].breakdown.uraAuthorized (explicit source-authorization adapter, not a V4 field)
OUTPUT: MapPublicSnapshot typed settlement records are identity-preserved from the fully compared MapEvent records
STRUCTURE: exactly 136 unique physical entities per state
hands/discards/sleeve/meld placement vs duplicate lists consistency
SOURCE_ONLY: breakdown.indicatorTiles (V5 ScoreBreakdownView has no indicator list; board dora is separate)
breakdown.score (V5 payload has event Score, not a breakdown-specific score field)
V4 breakdown.uraHits group count (cross-checked against V5 UraHits tile list, not a separate V5 field)
UNREPRESENTABLE: V4 legalActions -> V5 Policy/DecisionView (P3.3 supplies it; no same-shape field)
V4 SessionUpdate unfiltered visible events -> V5 has no unfiltered client event list
V4 closed-kan public meld identity -> V5 public board omits it (ConcealedMelds placeholder)
V4 per-river turnNumber assignment -> V5 DiscardView turnNumber uses river index

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 SessionUpdate.filterVisibleEvents passes CheatPointsChanged to every seat through its else branch.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: V4: seat0..3 all receive CheatPointsChanged. V5: ProtocolEventPolicy marks it private and only the owner seat receives it.
knownDivergences.status: BLOCKED for V4/V5 equality; V5 behavior is the stricter intended policy. Not counted as an aligned field.

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 PlayerView.legalActions carries deep-copied GameAction tiles; V5 PlayerSnapshotView.Private.Decision comes from a P3.3 DecisionView.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: No same-shape mapping: comparing V4 GameAction.DeclarePon to V5 LegalActionView would invent semantics.
knownDivergences.status: UNREPRESENTABLE; the V4 deep-copy behavior is proven by the Kotlin exporter only.

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 PublicBoardView publishes every meld including CLOSED_KAN tile identities.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: V5 public board omits a closed kan's four identities and exposes only a concealed placeholder/count.
knownDivergences.status: UNREPRESENTABLE/INTENTIONALLY STRICTER; no closed-kan case is counted as aligned in this fixture.

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 PlayerView.mySleeveTiles is part of the player view.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: V5 keeps sleeve identities in TableOwnerPrivateView; MapPlayerSnapshot then maps them into PrivatePlayerView.SleeveTiles for the owner only.
knownDivergences.status: REPRESENTATION MAPPING, not a leak: the owner mapped snapshot carries it; public/other-seat views do not.

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 PublicSessionSummary carries lifecycle, scores, roundRecords and finalResult.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: V5 PublicSessionSummary carries finished/finishReason/finalScores/rankings; round records are absent.
knownDivergences.status: UNREPRESENTABLE; only finished=false is compared for an active round.

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 publicEvents strips ScoreBreakdown.dora.uraTiles/uraHits when revealSettlementUra=false and restores them when true.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: V5 TableProjectedEvent is metadata-only, but TableProjectionEventFacts.Breakdown + MapEvent + ScoreBreakdownView are the existing full mapping path. The mapper does NOT auto-redact: a caller must pass uraAuthorized=false without ura identities (otherwise ScoreBreakdownView rejects), or authorize the raw breakdown.
knownDivergences.owner: P3.2 joined-map caller / P2.1 payload contract
knownDivergences.status: MAPPED + CALLER AUTHORIZATION CONTRACT; the golden now compares mapped UraTiles/UraHits/TotalPoints/DoraCount/UraCount and asserts the unauthorized raw breakdown is rejected.

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 wallRemaining = wallEndExclusive - wallPointer; V4 keeps the full wall list.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: V5 WallRemaining counts physical Wall-zone tiles in [0, WallEndExclusive). Mapping uses a dense live-wall suffix and WallPointer=0.
knownDivergences.status: REPRESENTATION MAPPING; values are compared after canonicalization, raw V4 pointers are SOURCE_ONLY.

knownDivergences.v4Observed: V4 dora indicator list is public; ura indicators are separate and never in PlayerView.
knownDivergences.v5Observed: V5 requires dora indicators to live in dead-wall slots >=4 and never exposes ura indicators in board/player views.
knownDivergences.status: ALIGNED BEHAVIOR; the V5 structural requirement is stronger and is asserted in C#.

contentHashPolicy: sourceHashes[].sha256RawBytes hashes the raw checked-out bytes; sourceHashes[].sha256LfNormalized hashes UTF-8 text after CRLF->LF replacement. They are never mixed. renderSha256LfNormalized hashes this document with the renderSha256LfNormalized value set to null; it binds every case/meta byte without a self-reference. The final file is LF-terminated and its actual SHA-256 is reported by the delivery report from the file, never hand-written here.

cases.title: PlayerView deep snapshot survives later source-state, meld and legal-action mutation

sourceOnly.legalActions: V4 PlayerView.legalActions is a V4 session-layer snapshot; V5 carries a P3.3 DecisionView supplied by the actor instead. The V4 legal-action deep copy is exercised here and is not re-derived in C#.
sourceOnly.meldSourceClearProof: View retained 3 meld tiles after the producer list was cleared.

cases.title: SessionUpdate event copy and per-seat/ura visibility

sourceOnly.sessionUpdateWholesaleCopy: V4 SessionUpdate stores every event before filtering. V5 never hands an unfiltered event list to a client; TableEventProjection.ProjectMany returns only audience-visible events. The V4 copy result is recorded as evidence, not re-derived in C#.
sourceOnly.cheatPointsChanged: V4 SessionUpdate.filterVisibleEvents passes CheatPointsChanged through its else branch to every seat, while V5 classifies it private. This divergence is listed in knownDivergences and is not counted as aligned.

cases.title: PublicProjectionFactory whitelist, ura authorization and deep copy

sourceOnly.tsumoBreakdown: V4 expected breakdown is the source value; the C# binding builds TableProjectionEventFacts from the raw input event and compares the mapped ProjectedEventPayload.Breakdown. The mapper does not auto-redact: the caller must pass uraAuthorized=false with no ura identities (raw identities are rejected), or explicitly authorize the raw breakdown.
sourceOnly.sessionSummary: V4 PublicSessionSummary carries lifecycle/scores/roundRecords/finalResult; V5 PublicSessionSummary carries finished/finishReason/finalScores/rankings. Only finished=false is comparable. See knownDivergences VG-D05.

cases.title: Real 136-entity state: owner/other-seat/spectator values, hand counts only, wall/ura/cheat hidden

sourceOnly.drawSource: V4 does not persist a draw source; the C# binding uses DEAL_EXTRA for the dealer's 14th tile and WALL otherwise. The source is not compared.
sourceOnly.discardFlags: V4 GameState does not persist per-discard turnNumber/riichiDiscard/tsumogiri. V5 DiscardView is built with turnNumber=river index and both flags false; only TileId and order are compared.
